inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL built-in-function smoke query exercises signed values with SIGN, formats decimal output, and converts an integer between numeric bases with CONV.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one negative metric while preserving the combined SIGN, FORMAT, ABS, and CONV report under deterministic ordering.

fixture_notes: Metric 10 has the fixed value -26.50. Its absolute integral magnitude is converted to hexadecimal and formatted with two decimal places.
determinism_notes: Metric ID and value are fixed and the final scalar report orders by metric ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE signed_metrics (metric_id INT PRIMARY KEY, metric_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT metric_id, metric_value, SIGN(metric_value) AS polarity, FORMAT(ABS(metric_value), 2) AS formatted_magnitude, CONV(CAST(ABS(metric_value) AS UNSIGNED), 10, 16) AS hexadecimal_magnitude FROM signed_metrics ORDER BY metric_id
